history.summary: UNCERTAIN IDENTITY — flagged placeholder: no web-documented 'Bhagwati Temple' exists in Sanguem taluka. Goa's well-known Bhagwati shrines are the Shri Bhagavati temples at Parshem/Pernem (North Goa, ~50 km away), not Sanguem. This row likely refers to a small undocumented local shrine, or is a CSV error conflating with the Pernem Bhagwati temple. Coordinates below are approximate (Sanguem town), and no image is attached because no reliable referent — and therefore no on-topic image — could be established. Do not treat this record as a verified temple entry.

town_description: Sanguem is an inland town in South Goa and the headquarters of Sanguem taluka, set on the road toward the Western Ghats; it is the gateway to the Netravali Wildlife Sanctuary and the Tambdi Surla temple.

travel.airport: Goa International Airport (Dabolim), about 60 km by road (approx.)
travel.road: Sanguem town, South Goa — well connected by road from Margao and Quepem
